snippet.title: Occult: Scarlet Elegy - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Delve into an occult society of exorcists and spirit mediums through the eyes of Lily: a shy healer possessed by the spirit known as Lament. Explore atmospheric 3D environments, build relationships with your team, and fight stylish turn-based battles in this love letter to "Those who are alone."

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4945010/Occult_Scarlet_Elegy/

Developer: Biomacchia
